snippet.title: Saints Row - XBOX 360 (2006) / Footage 14 / 'Exclusive Unkut Pack & Funky Fresh Pack' DLC
snippet.description:
The original 'Saints Row' is an interesting beast and definitely worth a second glance in 2024/25.  Geez, it's hard to believe this title is nearing 20 years old already - initially released back in 2006 during the XBOX 360's very early years.  It was a special game for its time no doubt, and basically refined the whole open-world / free-roaming genre of GTA titles and their respective clones.  The overall customization options within, along with the superior control scheme (sporting improved dual analog aiming) made this crazy world in Stilwater a serious contender for other GTA games around this time.

Whatever the case may be, after revisiting my 'saved game progress' from eons ago, I was able to mostly pick-up where I left off and my created character was all ready to roll into a new era.  Ehh, I never invested much time into the first 'Saints Row' (8 hours maybe?), but still thoroughly appreciated the quirkiness this franchise had to offer.  Needless to say, it would be nice (at the very least) running through the main Story Missions in due time, mainly to catch-up on the game / franchise's origin. 

At the moment, I'm still experimenting with various features / options in-game to see what works best when grabbing footage.  First off, this game has a serious "screen-tearing" problem (most likely stemming from technical limitations at the time), which thankfully can be rectified by toggling the V-Sync to 'On' in the display options menu.  This was a neat little feature the devs made available with a subsequent update during the game's heyday.  Naturally, having to take a slight hit to the frame rate in the process seems to be the only caveat, but also a sacrifice worth making.

Furthermore, I'm still wondering how to deal with the audio in Saints.  Of course the music / radio stations play licensed tunes, and these songs obviously don't mesh well with YouTube's copyright restrictions / guidelines.  Turning everything off (music-related in the options) helps prevent any copyright entanglements all-together, but also detracts a bit from the overall experience... as the game was intended to be played.  Hmm, so far I've left everything muted that could cause a problem, but perhaps I'll keep the music on and then simply edit out anything that gets potentially flagged once uploaded.  Yeah, these particular gaming vids with licensed tunes always pose a hazard.

All in all, 'Saints Row' is a fun ride throughout (albeit a tad low-brow) and provides players with enough zany activities to engage in for hours on-end.  Despite the original game in this series feeling somewhat archaic to the various sequels released in following years, it's still interesting to get a taste of this XBOX 360 exclusive, which ultimately kicked-off a memorable franchise rivaling that of 'Grand Theft Auto'.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ACHIEVEMENT...

47:58 - Jumped the Shark - 10 Gamerscore
- Withdraw a total of $200,000 from the Loan Office. (Secret)
